description: This PHP source file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class named InterviewAttachmentSearchFilterParams within the OrangeHRM Recruitment module. The class extends a base FilterParams class and provides filtering parameters for searching interview attachments, specifically including an interview ID property with getter and setter methods. It also defines allowed sort fields.

classes.name: InterviewAttachmentSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class that encapsulates filter parameters for searching interview attachments, focusing on the interview ID and sort fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter params object and sets default sort field to 'attachment.interviewId'.

methods.name: getInterviewId
methods.description: Returns the interview ID used as a filter parameter.

methods.name: setInterviewId
methods.description: Sets the interview ID for filtering.
